alt_text: Paired-difference panels compare Mall with Walk, Walk with PT, and Mall with PT across accepted dates for available heart-rate, HRV, and mechanical metrics.
interpretation: Paired differences are interpreted per metric and comparison; mixed direction is retained rather than converted into a universal result.
limitations: Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
long_description: Paired differences are interpreted per metric and comparison; mixed direction is retained rather than converted into a universal result. Positive and negative differences retain each metric's stated direction rule. Unavailable Stress/SNS/PNS comparisons have no plotted values. Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
qualifications: Positive and negative differences retain each metric's stated direction rule.
Unavailable Stress/SNS/PNS comparisons have no plotted values.
source_labels: Accepted Mall → Walk → PT Skate protocol
title: Accepted-triplet paired comparisons
